metadata.title: Chayote Squash Momo | Northeastern recipe
metadata.description:
Momos are an all time favorite food of mine. Momos can be made with different type of fillings. In this video  I am making momos with Chayote Squash, which are grown abundantly in the Northeastern part of India. Chayote Squash momos tastes better than their vegetable counterpart the cabbage momos. 

Ingredients: 

All purpose flour (maida) - 1 cup
Chayote Squash (Chou Chou) - 2 nos
Onion - Medium sized 2 nos
Butter - 2 tablespoons (you can use any cooking oil instead)
Salt - to taste
Water - As required
